chunks: Ahmad ibn Ziyad ibn Ja'far al-Hamadani (may Allah have mercy on him) narrated to us. He said: Ali ibn Ibrahim ibn Hashim narrated to us, from his father, from Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr, from Hamza ibn Humran, who said:

I visited al-Sadiq Ja'far ibn Muhammad (peace be upon them both), and he said to me: O Hamza, where have you come from? I said to him: From Kufa. He said: Then he (peace be upon him) wept until his tears soaked his beard. So I said to him: O son of the Messenger of Allah, why have you wept so much? He said: I remembered my uncle Zayd and what was done to him, so I wept.

I said to him: And what did you remember of it? He said: I remembered his killing. An arrow had struck his forehead, so his son Yahya came to him and bent over him, and said to him: Be glad, O father, for you will meet the Messenger of Allah, Ali, Fatima, al-Hasan, and al-Husayn (blessings of Allah be upon them). He said: Yes, my son. Then he called for a blacksmith, who extracted the arrow from his forehead, and his soul departed with it.

He was then taken to a waterway that flowed near the garden of Zaida, and a grave was dug for him there and he was buried, and water was made to flow over him. Among them was a servant from Sindh belonging to one of them, and he went to Yusuf ibn Umar the next morning and informed him of their burying of him. So Yusuf ibn Umar exhumed him and crucified him in Kunasa for four years. Then it was ordered that he be burned with fire, and his ashes were scattered in the winds.

May Allah curse his killer and his betrayer. And to Allah, exalted is His name, I complain of what has befallen us, the Ahl al-Bayt of His Prophet, after his death. And through Him we seek help against our enemy, and He is the best helper.

key_terms.أهل بيت نبيه: The Ahl al-Bayt (People of the House) of His Prophet, referring to the Prophet's family
key_terms.الكناسة: Al-Kunasa, a marketplace/square in Kufa where bodies were publicly displayed
key_terms.مقتل: The killing / manner of death (maqtal), a term specifically used for martyrdom accounts

ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Sadiq say about the martyrdom of Zayd ibn Ali?
ai.summary: Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq (AS) weeps when Hamza ibn Humran visits from Kufa, as it reminds him of his uncle Zayd ibn Ali's martyrdom. Zayd was struck by an arrow during his uprising against the Umayyads in 122 AH in Kufa. His son Yahya consoled him at his deathbed, and after his death, followers buried him secretly in a waterway. However, a slave betrayed the burial location to the Umayyad governor Yusuf ibn Umar, who exhumed Zayd's body, crucified it publicly for four years, then burned and scattered the remains. The Imam closes with a powerful lament for the suffering of the Prophet's household.
